title: Northgate Store and Online Orders Fulfilment Fee Schedule
content:
Fulfilment fees of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, by fulfilment program. Each figure below is the program's own published charge; how a fee is charged, waived or lowered is governed by the order fee rules.

| Program | Standard fulfilment fee | Booked as fee type | Merchandise subtotal at or above which the standard fee is waived for every customer | Express fee | Express window | Haul-away fee per old item | Late cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | 0.00 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 hours | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Northgate Order Pickup | 0.00 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 hours | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Northgate Drive Up | 0.00 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 hours | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Northgate Ship to Home | 5.99 | shipping | 35.00 | not applicable | 0 hours | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | 9.99 | same-day delivery | not applicable | 14.99 | 2 hours | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | 49.00 | large-item delivery | not applicable | not applicable | 0 hours | 25.00 | 49.00 |

All amounts are in US dollars.

**Definitions carried with the schedule.**
- *Standard fulfilment fee*: the standard fulfilment fee charged to a customer without a waiving benefit (shipping, same-day delivery or large-item delivery), booked as the fee type shown.
- *Waiver threshold*: the merchandise subtotal at or above which the standard fee is waived for every customer; "not applicable" where no such threshold exists.
- *Express fee and express window*: the fee for express delivery, delivered within the express window of the number of hours shown; "not applicable" and 0 hours where express is not offered.
- *Haul-away fee*: the fee per old item hauled away at delivery; "not applicable" where not offered.
- *Late cancellation fee*: the fee for canceling a large-item delivery after the cutoff; 0.00 where not applicable.

**Benefit eligibility and delivery conditions by program.**

| Program | Membership delivery benefits can apply to the program's fees | Northgate Card free-shipping benefit can apply to the program's fee | Delivery requires an adult signature |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | no | no | no |
| Northgate Order Pickup | no | no | no |
| Northgate Drive Up | no | no | no |
| Northgate Ship to Home | yes | yes | no |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | yes | no | no |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | no | no | yes |

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustration).** A Ship to Home order whose merchandise subtotal is exactly the waiver threshold has its standard fee waived; one a cent below it does not reach the threshold. A program showing "not applicable" in a column has no such charge at all.
